/.title: Bitcoin Stamps: Unprunable UTXO Art | Stampchain
/.description: Browse, buy and create Bitcoin Stamps: art written straight into Bitcoin UTXOs, plus SRC-20 tokens, curated collections and a live explorer.

/marketplace.title: Buy Bitcoin Stamps | Stamp Marketplace
/marketplace.description: Every Bitcoin Stamp currently listed, priced in BTC and USD. Filter by classic, posh, recursive or cursed, and see what has actually been selling.

/src20.title: SRC-20 Tokens: Prices, Holders and Open Mints
/src20.description: Live price, 24h change, volume, market cap and holder count for every SRC-20 token on Bitcoin, plus which tickers are still open to mint.

/collection.title: Bitcoin Stamps Collections | Browse Series
/collection.description: Curated Bitcoin Stamps collections from KEVIN to STAMPEPES, each with its stamp count, holder count and lowest listed price.

/explorer.title: Bitcoin Stamps Explorer | Stamps and SRC-20
/explorer.description: Search every stamp issuance and SRC-20 transfer on Bitcoin. Filter to stamps or tokens and follow activity by address, ticker or stamp number.

/block.title: Bitcoin Stamps by Block | Block Explorer
/block.description: Stamp issuances and SRC-20 operations in each Bitcoin block, alongside current fee rates, average block time and the latest blocks as they confirm.

/about.title: About Stampchain | Who Built Bitcoin Stamps
/about.description: Mike In Space conceived the Bitcoin Stamps meta-protocol. Arwyn and Reinamora built it out. Meet the founders, and the dev fund behind Stampchain.

/faq.title: Bitcoin Stamps FAQ: Types, Wallets, Trading
/faq.description: What Bitcoin Stamps are, how Classic, SRC-20, SRC-721 and OLGA differ, which wallets work, what file sizes fit, and how stamps compare to Ordinals.

/docs.title: Stampchain API Docs | Bitcoin Stamps REST API
/docs.description: Reference for the Stampchain v2 API. Endpoints for stamps, SRC-20 balances, collections, blocks and addresses, with v2.2 and v2.3 request schemas.

/howto.title: Bitcoin Stamps How-To Guides | Step by Step
/howto.description: Guides for Bitcoin Stamps: set up a Leather wallet, connect it, buy your first stamp, stamp your own art, and deploy or mint an SRC-20 token.

/howto/buy.title: How to Buy a Bitcoin Stamp | Step by Step
/howto/buy.description: Buy a stamp from a dispenser. Connect a wallet, fund it with BTC, pick a listing on the marketplace, then send the exact amount the dispenser expects.

/howto/stamp.title: How to Stamp Your Art on Bitcoin
/howto/stamp.description: Write an image straight into Bitcoin. Connect a wallet, open the create tool, upload your art, choose editions and a name, set the fee and broadcast.

/howto/sendstamp.title: How to Send a Bitcoin Stamp to Another Wallet
/howto/sendstamp.description: Transfer a stamp you own. Open the send tool under Tools, choose the stamp, enter the destination address, set your fee and sign in your wallet.

/howto/deploytoken.title: How to Deploy an SRC-20 Token on Bitcoin
/howto/deploytoken.description: Deploy your own SRC-20 ticker. Pick a name of 5 characters or fewer, set supply, decimals and mint limit, upload 420x420 art, then sign and broadcast.

/howto/minttoken.title: How to Mint an SRC-20 Token | Bitcoin Stamps
/howto/minttoken.description: Mint an SRC-20 ticker that is still open. Open the mint tool, choose the token and amount, set your fee, then confirm the transaction in your wallet.

/howto/transfertoken.title: How to Transfer SRC-20 Tokens
/howto/transfertoken.description: Send SRC-20 tokens to another Bitcoin address. Open the transfer tool, choose the ticker and amount, set your fee and sign the transaction.

/howto/leatherconnect.title: Connect a Bitcoin Stamps Wallet to Stampchain
/howto/leatherconnect.description: Leather, Unisat, OKX, TapWallet, Phantom and Horizon all connect to stampchain.io. This walkthrough uses Leather, from Connect through wallet approval.

/howto/leathercreate.title: Create a Leather Wallet for Bitcoin Stamps
/howto/leathercreate.description: Install the Leather extension in Chrome or Brave, create a wallet and back up the secret key. Start here if you are new to Bitcoin Stamps.

/howto/transferbitname.title: How to Transfer a Bitname | Bitcoin Stamps
/howto/transferbitname.description: Moving a bitname to another Bitcoin address. This guide is still being written, and the transfer option has not landed in the Tools menu yet.

/tool/stamp/create.title: Create a Bitcoin Stamp | Stamping Tool
/tool/stamp/create.description: Stamp artwork into Bitcoin. Upload a file, set the edition count, choose a custom CPID or posh name, lock the supply and tune the fee before signing.

/create/classic.title: Create a Classic Stamp | Stampchain
/create/classic.description: Stamp artwork into Bitcoin as a numeric classic stamp. Upload a file, set the editions, lock the supply and tune the fee before signing.

/create/posh.title: Create a Posh Stamp | Stampchain
/create/posh.description: Create a posh Bitcoin Stamp with a name you choose. Upload a file, pick a B-Z name (needs XCP), set the editions and lock supply before signing.

/create/recursive.title: Create a Recursive Stamp | Stampchain
/create/recursive.description: Build a recursive Bitcoin Stamp from stamps already on-chain. Arrange the layers, name the piece, then sign and broadcast.

/tool/fairmint.title: Fairmint Counterparty Assets | Stampchain
/tool/fairmint.description: Fairmint an open Counterparty asset. Pick a fairminter or enter an asset name, set the quantity, check the estimated fee and sign in your wallet.

/media.title: Bitcoin Stamps in the Media | Press and Video
/media.description: Interviews with Mike In Space, news coverage and research on Bitcoin Stamps, including the SQRR deep dive and podcast appearances on Rice TVX.

/presskit.title: Bitcoin Stamps Press Kit | Logos and Colors
/presskit.description: Brand assets for the Bitcoin Stamps protocol and Stampchain: logos in SVG and PNG, colour palettes, typefaces and the stamp and SRC-20 icon set.

/upload.title: Upload SRC-20 Token Artwork | Stampchain
/upload.description: Add or replace the image shown for an SRC-20 ticker, alongside the deployed token list with creator, block, max supply, mint limit and decimals.

/termsofservice.title: Terms of Service | Stampchain
/termsofservice.description: The legal terms covering use of stampchain.io, its stamping and token tools, and its API. Last updated 11 September 2024.

/stamp.title: All Bitcoin Stamps | Browse Every Stamp
/stamp.description: Every stamp issued on Bitcoin, newest first. Filter by type, sort by stamp number or price, and open any piece for its full on-chain history.

/tool/stamp/trade.title: Trade Bitcoin Stamps | Dispensers and Offers
/tool/stamp/trade.description: Open or take a stamp dispenser on Bitcoin. Set the price and quantity, review the fee estimate and sign the transaction in your wallet.

/tool/stamp/send.title: Send Stamps | Stampchain Tools
/tool/stamp/send.description: Send Bitcoin Stamps from your own wallet. Set the details, review the fee estimate and sign the transaction on stampchain.io.

/tool/src20/mint.title: Mint SRC-20 Tokens | Stampchain Tools
/tool/src20/mint.description: Mint an SRC-20 token on Bitcoin. Fill in the ticker details, review the fee estimate and sign the transaction in your wallet.

/tool/src101/register.title: Register a Bitname | Stampchain Tools
/tool/src101/register.description: Register an SRC-101 bitname on Bitcoin. Fill in the details, review the fee estimate and sign the transaction in your wallet.

/howto/foo-bar.title: Foo Bar | Bitcoin Stamps How-To
/howto/foo-bar.description: Step-by-step guide to foo bar on stampchain.io, with the wallet setup and fee settings each step needs.

/collection/kevin-stamps.title: Kevin Stamps Collection | Bitcoin Stamps
/collection/kevin-stamps.description: Every stamp in the Kevin Stamps collection on Bitcoin, with edition counts, holders and the lowest listed price for each piece.

/src20/kevin.title: KEVIN SRC-20 Token | Price and Holders
/src20/kevin.description: Live price, supply, mint progress, holder count and transfer history for the KEVIN SRC-20 token on Bitcoin.

/block/973800.title: Bitcoin Block 973800 | Stamps and SRC-20
/block/973800.description: Stamp issuances and SRC-20 operations confirmed in Bitcoin block 973800, with the transactions and neighbouring blocks around it.

/stamp/12345.title: Bitcoin Stamp 12345 | Stampchain
/stamp/12345.description: Bitcoin Stamp 12345: the artwork, its editions and holders, the dispensers offering it, and every transfer recorded against it on-chain.

/wallet/bc1qxy2kgdygjrsqtzq2n0yrf2493p83.title: bc1qxy2kgdygjrsqtzq2n0yrf2493p83kkfjhx0wlh | Stamps Wallet
/wallet/bc1qxy2kgdygjrsqtzq2n0yrf2493p83.description: Stamps, SRC-20 balances and BTC held by bc1qxy2kgdygjrsqtzq2n0yrf2493p83kkfjhx0wlh, plus everything this address has created, listed or sold on Bitcoin.

/dashboard/1BoatSLRHtKNngkdXEeobR76b53LE.title: 1BoatSLRHtKNngkdXEeobR76b53LETtpyT | Dashboard
/dashboard/1BoatSLRHtKNngkdXEeobR76b53LE.description: Manage the stamps and SRC-20 tokens held by 1BoatSLRHtKNngkdXEeobR76b53LETtpyT: balances, open listings and the transfers this address has signed.

HOW-TO

REGISTER YOUR BITNAME

  • Select your preferred Top Level Domain from the .btc dropdown menu. We support multiple TLDs, such as .btc, .sats, .x.
  • Type in the domain name you want to claim.
  • Click the availability button to check if the domain is already registered or available.
  • If the domain name isn't claimed, you can proceed to register it.
  • Set the desired transaction fee by adjusting the fee selector slider. We do not advise setting a fee lower than the recommended fee.
  • An estimate of the total cost of the registration is displayed. You can view a breakdown of the domain registration and transaction fees, in the details dropdown section.
  • Accept the terms of service to enable the register button.
  • Click the register button to submit your transaction with all the provided details and confirm the transaction in your wallet.

Reducing the transaction fee may slow down the registration process.
All fees are shown in BTC by default. You can view the costs in USDT by switching the toggle.
You can check the progress of the registration by viewing your tx hash in a blockchain explorer.
